name: Terry Davis: An Idiot Admires Complexity
aliases: an idiot admires complexity a genius admires simplicity
description: Terry Davis speaks over TempleOS screens: "An idiot admires complexity, a genius admires simplicity... If you make something so clusterfucked he can't understand it, he's going to think you're a god because you made it so complicated nobody can understand it."
usage: Against overengineering. Reply to microservices for a todo app, jargon-filled papers, or a 40-step setup guide.

source.author: @Davisanism
source.example: “An idiot admires complexity, a genius admires simplicity.”
